scope: Accepted 1856–1857 batches 18–19 source-text rendering, chronology, attribution, receipt and enclosure requirements only; candidate for root review. No converter, export, transcript, corpus, training or primary evidence changes.

requirements.requirement: Preserve 11267 as the Bentham incoming response that retracts the earlier Arachis/Stylosanthes examples and supplies particular apetalous-legume cases; its relationship to 2005 is a reverse reply, not a generic continuity. Render “almost but not quite” anthers as qualified evidence: absence of visible anthers does not mean absence of pollen. Keep British violets and Russian observations distinct from Darwin annotations.

evidence.retained_body_scope: retained P2; raw DOM body locator to be resolved before implementation

requirements.case: missing annotated lists and Darwin key
requirements.requirement: Keep 2186’s damaged return of two lists separate from the absent annotated list rows: physical metadata mentioning Darwin lists does not supply an enclosure, figures or detailed entries. Likewise 1617 is Darwin’s key/memo with Bunbury marks and addenda quoted in apparatus, not ordinary Bunbury incoming prose; the full 96-species list is not transcribed. In 1871 retain plain “110” with no MathML and its rendering hold.

requirements.case: damaged Bunbury sources and quoted Hooker voice
requirements.requirement: Render 1830 as a damaged six-page ALS with its surviving Colletia discussion, uncertain seed origin and hearsay about Darwin’s views; preserve the conflicting botanical author descriptions (Duval/Dunal/apparatus) without choosing one silently. In 1854, keep Joseph Hooker’s quoted reply distinct from Bunbury’s inference and from undated Darwin notes; the cited incoming letter remains missing and the surviving letter ends mid-sentence.

requirements.case: Lowe contemporary Lyell copy and uncertain counts
requirements.requirement: Preserve 1852A as a contemporary Lyell copy of Lowe’s missing original, with uncertain Porto Santo totals, overlapping categories and explicitly qualified endemic estimates. The April 21 knowledge relation comes from Darwin’s marginal/context evidence, not an exact Lowe receipt or copying date; do not flatten doubtful ranges into exact counts or treat the flora plan as a finished received book.

evidence.retained_body_scope: retained body scope; raw DOM locator to be resolved before implementation

requirements.case: Doubleday complete F source, missing opening and larval evidence
requirements.requirement: Treat 2037F as a complete short ALS despite the F suffix. Preserve 2032’s missing opening and January 26–February 4 relational bounds; the February 5 reply 2047 answers a surviving local-variation portion but cannot reconstruct the absent opening or enclosure list. Keep 2047’s separate February 8 Darwin note as a known-by witness, not exact receipt. Similar-looking larvae and indiscriminate mating support conspecificity only contingently; they do not prove all forms came from one clutch.

implementation_boundary: Retained paragraph scopes and raw DOM paths are separate and must be preserved.
Keep copied text, quoted voices, annotations, missing enclosures, receipt and date bounds independently addressable.
Requirements do not create acceptance or export readiness.
notes: The 11267→2005 reverse edge is retained as accepted primary context; no duplicate graph edge is created.
The plain 110 rendering hold remains explicit because no MathML is present.
